# Parse the note content to identify songs needing release month info
content = note['content']
lines = content.split('\n')
songs_to_update = []
for line in lines:
    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:
        # Extract song title and artists
        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- "
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            line = line[2:]
        # Split on " BY " to get title and rest
        if ' BY ' in line:
            title_part, rest = line.split(' BY ', 1)
            # rest contains "Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT TODO"
            # Remove " RELEASED_AT TODO" at end
            artists_part = rest.replace(' RELEASED_AT TODO', '')
            songs_to_update.append({'title': title_part, 'artists': artists_part})
print(songs_to_update)

    if 'RELEASED_AT TODO' in line:

        # Format: "- Song Title BY Artists RELEASED_AT TODO"
        # Remove leading "- " and split on " BY "
        line_stripped = line.strip()
        if line_stripped.startswith('- '):

        title_part = line_stripped.split(' BY ')[0]
